# Agent Sandbox

> CLI (`abx`, Node.js/TypeScript) for the Alibaba Cloud FC Agent Sandbox service;
> the Python SDK lives in the `python-sdk` repository.
> E2B-protocol compatible with Alibaba Cloud extensions (OSS, VPC, custom domains).

## Purpose

Agent Sandbox lets AI agents and developers create, manage, and interact
with secure cloud sandboxes. It provides isolated execution environments for
running untrusted code, file operations, and shell commands — designed for
LLM tool-use and agentic workflows.

AI coding tools: read [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) — a static, tool-neutral Agent
Skills guide covering install, credential safety, MCP vs SDK selection,
sandbox lifecycle, file operations, and error diagnosis. The guide can be
installed into skills-aware tools (Qoder, Claude Code, Cursor, Qwen Code,
Codex, …) before the CLI/SDK is installed, with:

    npx skills add agent-sandbox/agent-sandbox --skill agent-sandbox -a <agent> -y

Full matrix (manual copy, Git sparse checkout, version pinning, uninstall):
docs/en/guide/agent-skill-installation.md

## Architecture

Layered CLI (lower layers never import upper layers; the client core mirrors the
Python SDK's layers, whose own architecture lives in the `python-sdk` repository):

- bin: `abx` executable entry (src/bin/abx.ts)
- framework: click-compatible command framework (parsing, help, exit codes)
- cli: main, OutputManager, formatters, command groups (src/cli/commands)
- agent / session: MCP server, template authoring, local session store
- api: Sandbox, files, code, commands, network, image, template
- protocol / transport: E2B-compatible REST + WebSocket, HTTP/2, API Key / AK-SK auth
- models / utils: typed models, error hierarchy, config, secret store, logging, retry

Details: docs/en/design/architecture.md

## Key Commands

Install: `npm install -g @agent-sandbox/cli`

```
abx create --template python-hello # create sandbox
abx exec <id> -- echo hello          # run command (--stream, --background)
abx run <id> <name> --arg k=v       # named command on the in-sandbox server
abx upload <id> ./local /remote     # file transfer
abx mcp start                       # start MCP server (STDIO)
abx kill <id>                       # destroy sandbox
```

## Source Layout

- src/transport/ — HTTP, WebSocket, auth, codec
- src/protocol/ — sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, process, terminal
- src/models/ — data models, error hierarchy
- src/api/ — Sandbox class, file/code/command/network APIs
- src/cli/ — CLI commands and formatters (on the mini click-compatible framework in src/framework/)
- src/agent/ — MCP server, tool definitions, template authoring
- src/bin/abx.ts — executable entry point
